summary.key_theme: Apple 成功推出首款摺疊手機 iPhone Duo 與 iPhone 18 Pro 系列，市場看好其硬體創新帶動的新一輪換機週期。

bullish.title: Apple makes biggest change to iPhone release cadence in 7 years in Ternus' first showcase as CEO
bullish.reason: 執行長 John Ternus 上任後首場發表會，推出首款摺疊手機與 iPhone 18 Pro，標誌著產品發布節奏的重大轉變，被視為推動未來成長的關鍵。

bullish.title: Apple's iPhone Duo, AI Strategy Strengthen Growth Outlook, Morgan Stanley Says
bullish.reason: 摩根士丹利指出，iPhone Duo 與 Siri AI 的結合顯著增強了 Apple 的長期成長前景，硬體與軟體創新同步加速。

bullish.title: Apple's Foldable Duo Represents 'Notable Form-Factor Change' for iPhone Lineup, UBS Says
bullish.reason: 瑞銀認為摺疊手機代表了 iPhone 產品線顯著的規格變革，有助於 Apple 擴大市占率。

bullish.title: Apple’s iPhone 18 Upgrade Cycle Likely to Boost Some Suppliers
bullish.reason: iPhone 18 系列的換機週期預計將帶動供應鏈需求，對整體生態系產生正面外溢效應。

bearish.title: Apple Prioritizing Volume Over Margins With Modest Pricing Strategy, Morgan Stanley Says
bearish.reason: 摩根士丹利分析指出 Apple 採取較保守的定價策略，優先考慮銷量而非利潤率，可能對短期毛利率造成壓力。

bearish.title: Apple Raises Prices on Existing iPhone Models in India by Up to 41%
bearish.reason: 在印度市場大幅調漲舊款 iPhone 價格高達 41%，可能影響該地區的銷售成長動能與消費者接受度。

bearish.title: The new Apple Watch can take notes on all of your conversations – and it could be controversial
bearish.reason: 新款 Apple Watch 的全時錄音與摘要功能引發隱私爭議，可能面臨監管審查風險。

neutral.title: To $370? Here Are 10 Top Analyst Forecasts For Thursday
neutral.reason: 分析師對 AAPL 目標價調整不一，市場反應呈現分歧，未有單一明確方向。

neutral.title: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Edge Higher Ahead Of PPI, Jobless Claims
neutral.reason: 受總體經濟數據（PPI、失業救濟金）公布前夕影響，市場情緒偏向觀望，AAPL 股價隨大盤波動。
